paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the length of the gold prefix and the BLEU score for two different consistency measures. The x-axis represents the length of the gold prefix, which is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20 with intervals of 5 units. The y-axis shows the BLEU score, with a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29, and tick intervals at 1 unit. There are two lines on the plot: one is a blue dashed line with circular markers representing "Consistency-CE", starting at a BLEU score of approximately 24.5 at a gold prefix length of 0, exhibiting a slight initial dip before increasing steadily to around 28 at a length of 20. The other line is a red solid line with square markers representing "Consistency-Bi," beginning at about 27.5 at a gold prefix length of 0, gradually declining to about 24 at a length of 20. The two lines intersect at around an x-value of 11. A legend is available on the bottom right of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
